# Mighty Plugs

> > Premium natural beeswax earplugs engineered for superior sound blocking, waterproof protection, and comfortable all-day wear across swimming, sleep, work, and recreational activities.

Mighty Plugs manufactures NRR34-rated earplugs made from natural beeswax, sterile cotton, and purified lanolin. Based in Ashland, Oregon, the company offers multiple pack sizes and specialized guides for different use cases including swimming, sleeping, work, concerts, and shooting sports.

## Key Topics

- NRR34 rating
- Beeswax earplugs
- Waterproof protection
- Sound blocking
- Natural ingredients
- Swimming earplugs
- Sleep earplugs
- Hearing protection
- Personal Pack
- Travel Pack
- Value Pack
- Sterile cotton
- Purified lanolin
- Occupational safety
- Concert hearing protection
